NOTICE AND AGENDA FOR EMERGENCY MEETING
  PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54956.5

  CITY COUNCIL

  MARCH 19, 2020

  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor of the City of Norwalk has called an EMERGENCY MEETING
of the City Council beginning at 4:00 p.m. on Thursday, March 19, 2020 in the City Council Chambers, Norwalk City
Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard. The agenda for the EMERGENCY MEETING is as follows:

  (Members of the public are entitled to comment only on the items listed)

TEMPORARY PUBLIC COMMENT EMAIL ESTABLISHED FOR CITY OF NORWALK CITY COUNCIL
MEETINGS. PLEASE LIMIT EMAILS TO ONLY THE ITEMS ON THIS AGENDA AND TO 250 WORDS. CITY
EMAIL: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov

CALL TO ORDER  Mayor Rios

ROLL CALL  City Clerk

CLOSED SESSION

 I. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNCIL PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE §54957: THREAT TO
  PUBLIC SERVICES OR FACILITIES – Consultation with the City Manager, Los Angeles County Sheriff
  representative, and other related City officials.

REPORT

RESOLUTION NO. 20-18 - CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION PROCLAIMING  A  LOCAL
EMERGENCY DUE TO THE EPIDEMIC CREATED BY THE COVID-19 VIRUS

Staff recommends City Council:

a. provide direction to staff regarding strategies and action to address continued public services in light of the
  current COVID-19 virus; and

  - Continued on Pg. 2 -
 b. consider adopting Resolution No. 20-18, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK DECLARING AND PROCLAIMING THE EXISTENCE OF A LOCAL EMERGENCY DUE TO THE
  EFFECTS OF COVID-19 AND THE EFFECTS AND IMPACTS UPON THE OPERATIONS OF GOVERNMENT
  WITHIN THE CITY OF NORWALK.

ADJOURNMENT

Dated this 19th day of March 2020.

I, Theresa Devoy, City Clerk, hereby certify that the foregoing notice of special meeting was posted at City Hall in
compliance with Government Code Section 54956.5 and emailed to Herald American, Cerritos Community News,
Norwalk Patriot, and Whittier Daily News.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, please
contact the City Clerk’s Department at (562) 929-5720 prior to the start of the meeting. Staff will make every effort to
accommodate the request. (28 CFR 35.102-35.104 ADA Title II)
